title: Server Commitment and Storage Allowance Figures — Continuum Backup & Recovery
content:
Four tier figures of Continuum Backup & Recovery set how many servers a plan is billed for at the least and how much protected server storage comes with each billed server: the minimum server commitment percentage, the storage included per billed server, the overage rate per TB, and the increment overage storage is rounded up to.

## Figures by tier

| Tier | Minimum billed servers, as a percent of contracted servers (rounded up) | Protected storage included per billed server per month (TB) | Overage rate per TB per month (USD) | Overage rounded up to (TB) |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| Continuum Backup Basic | 0 | 0.5 | 28 | 0.25 |
| Continuum Backup Standard | 0 | 1 | 26 | 0.25 |
| Continuum Backup Plus | 80 | 1 | 24 | 0.25 |
| Continuum BDR | 90 | 2 | 22 | 0.1 |
| Continuum DRaaS | 90 | 2 | 20 | 0.1 |
| Continuum DRaaS Premier | 100 | 4 | 18 | 0.1 |

## Meaning of each column

- **Minimum server commitment percentage.** The minimum number of billed servers, expressed as a percent of the plan's contracted servers, the resulting count rounded up to a whole server. At 0 percent the commitment sets no minimum above zero.
- **Included storage.** The protected storage included per billed server per month, in TB.
- **Overage rate.** The monthly rate per TB of protected server storage above the pooled allowance, in USD per TB.
- **Overage rounding.** The increment, in TB, that overage storage is rounded up to.

## Rounding the commitment (hypothetical server counts)

| Tier | Contracted servers (hypothetical) | Percent of contracted servers | Minimum billed servers after rounding up |
|---|---|---|---|
| Continuum Backup Plus | 4 | 80 percent gives 3.2 | 4 |
| Continuum BDR | 5 | 90 percent gives 4.5 | 5 |
| Continuum DRaaS | 10 | 90 percent gives 9 | 9 |
| Continuum DRaaS Premier | 3 | 100 percent gives 3 | 3 |

## Rounding overage storage (hypothetical overage)

A hypothetical 0.32 TB above the allowance rounds up to 0.5 TB on a tier with a 0.25 TB increment, and to 0.4 TB on a tier with a 0.1 TB increment.
